source_name: NBS – Access to NBS payment systems (participation conditions document, July 2025)
why_relevant: Sets out how non-bank PSPs (payment institutions, EMIs) may join SIPS/TARGET-SK from 6 Oct 2025 — a structural change in who can access national clearing, directly relevant to competitive landscape.

source_name: NBS – Legislatíva: Opatrenie NBS č. 16/2014 o uverejňovaní informácií bankami a pobočkami zahraničných bánk (incl. amendment 8/2023)
why_relevant: The legal instrument that defines WHAT every Slovak bank must disclose, in which tables, and at what frequency (alongside CRR Part Eight). Reading it tells the collector exactly which structured tables to expect in each bank's 'Informácie o banke' PDF and when a template change will break parsers. Amendments (13/2015, 15/2018, 8/2023) signal schema shifts.

source_name: NBS – ESEF guidance for Slovak issuers (deferral, XHTML/iXBRL obligation)
why_relevant: Defines the machine-readability boundary for the SK cell: Slovakia used the one-year ESEF deferral, so mandatory XHTML (and iXBRL tagging of IFRS consolidated statements) applies from FY2021 reports filed in 2022 onward; PDF-only annual financial reports are explicitly treated as non-compliance with §34 Securities Act. This tells the collector that SK bank annual financial reports from 2022 onwards should be structured-parseable, while earlier years are PDF.

source_name: NBS SEPA implementation plan and SEPA archive documents
why_relevant: Historical migration plan naming every SK actor (NBS, MF SR, Štátna pokladnica, banks, SBA) and the infrastructure milestones — a ready-made actor map for the national clearing ecosystem.

source_name: NBS Annual Report (Výročná správa NBS) – payment systems chapter
why_relevant: The NBS annual report contains a dedicated payment-systems chapter with SIPS/TARGET operating figures, incidents and infrastructure projects — a recurring, comparable disclosure series.

source_name: Úrad pre reguláciu elektronických komunikácií a poštových služieb (RÚ) – report on universal service and postal payment transactions
why_relevant: The postal regulator's annual 'Správa o stave poskytovania univerzálnej služby a poštového platobného styku' is the only official series covering postal payment-transaction provision quality/volumes — a regulator-audited counterpart to Slovenská pošta's own report.

source_name: RÚZ public-part user manual (Príručka používateľa, PDF)
why_relevant: Documents the search semantics, document types and attachment structure of the public RÚZ, including how consolidated vs individual statements and annual reports are stored — needed to build a correct crawler and to interpret missing filings.

source_name: VÚB Banka — investor presentation / covered bond investor materials
why_relevant: Covered-bond investor decks compile rating-agency assessments, cover-pool asset quality and funding metrics in one file — analyst-grade numbers issued for a rating/investor audience rather than press.

source_name: Erste Group CDN — Slovenska sporitelna standalone investor presentation
why_relevant: Debt-investor presentation for the SK subsidiary, hosted on Erste's group CDN rather than a purely local site: gives SK-only balance sheet, market shares, covered-bond programme and funding detail in English. Demonstrates that group CDN paths (cdn0.erstegroup.com/content/dam/sk/slsp/...) are a harvestable channel for SK-specific documents.

source_name: Erste Group — Key Financials / Financial Data Sheets (XLSX)
why_relevant: Machine-readable spreadsheet of Erste Group's segment reporting, which includes a discrete 'Slovakia' geographic segment (Slovenska sporitelna): P&L, balance sheet, NIM, cost/income, risk costs, loan and deposit volumes per quarter. Highest-value quantitative SK banking series available outside NBS statistics, and already tabular.

source_name: Slovenská pošta – SKPAY service page
why_relevant: State-owned Slovenská pošta documents SKPAY's role as the payment/e-money institution behind post-office payment services, revealing the distribution and ownership structure of a major SK EMI. Slovenská pošta's own annual report is an indirect window on SKPAY volumes.

source_name: Deloitte — CEE Banking M&A Study (annual)
why_relevant: Annual study covering ~16 CEE countries with a Slovakia chapter: ownership, consolidation, profitability and asset quality; the standard reference for SK banking M&A and market-structure shifts.

source_name: ČSOB Slovensko – Informácie zverejňované ročne / štvrťročne (Pillar 3-type disclosures)
why_relevant: Regulatory periodic-disclosure PDFs (capital, risk, exposures) required of SK banks — a standardised, comparable series distinct from marketing-flavoured annual reports.

source_name: 365.bank / Poštová banka – annual reports and IR pages
why_relevant: The bank contractually distributing through ~all post offices; its consolidated annual report discloses the economics and duration of the Slovenská pošta partnership — the bridge between postal infrastructure and banking.

source_name: Visa Awards Slovensko (via Forbes.sk event coverage)
why_relevant: Visa's separate Slovak awards edition rewards banks that push payment innovation; 2025 coverage reports Slovakia among the first European markets to complete an AI-agent-initiated transaction, with Slovenska sporitelna, Tatra banka, VUB and CSOB as winners. Exactly the kind of first-stated milestone this cell exists to catch.

entity_name: KBC Group M&A / transaction disclosures on Slovakia
source_name: KBC Group Annual Report (consolidated, jvs-yyyy series)
why_relevant: Annual consolidated report with segment note and country detail for Slovakia (CSOB SK banking, insurance, leasing, asset management), plus risk, capital and ESG disclosures at subsidiary granularity.

source_name: RBI Raiffeisen blog — market trends / country commentary on Slovakia
why_relevant: Parent-group research/commentary specifically on the Slovak financial market (structure, challenges, outlook, bank levy). Qualitative context that frames the quantitative segment data and signals the parent's strategic read of SK.

source_name: RBI quarterly 'Results Internet' workbook (XLSM)
why_relevant: Machine-readable quarterly results workbook accompanying the RBI interim report — the tabular route to Tatra banka / Slovakia country-segment figures without PDF table extraction. Macro-enabled Excel, so sandbox on ingest.

source_name: EXIMBANKA SR – news / results announcements
why_relevant: Interim and full-year performance announcements (banking vs insurance split, supported export volumes) ahead of the formal annual report.

source_name: IMF — Slovak Republic Article IV consultation reports
why_relevant: Annual independent country note with a dedicated financial-sector section: concentration (top-5 ≈ 3/4 of assets), foreign-ownership share, profitability, buffers, RRE vulnerabilities and macroprudential settings — validation data no SK bank publishes about the system.

source_name: IMF — Slovak Republic Financial Sector Assessment Program (FSAP) technical notes
why_relevant: Deep, infrequent (once-a-decade-ish) technical notes on systemic risk, stress testing and the macroprudential framework — the single richest independent quantitative dossier on the SK banking system.

source_name: SME / index.sme.sk and SITA – trade press on SK payment infrastructure
why_relevant: Slovak business press covers infrastructure launches, outages and postal-bank contract news that institutions disclose only tersely; useful for dating events and for names of vendors/officials.

source_name: Podnikajte.sk - comparative reviews of SK payment gateways and acceptance pricing
why_relevant: Periodically refreshed SK-market comparison of payment gateways/acceptance providers with fee structures. Reveals-indirectly: gives an observable proxy for SK acceptance pricing and which acquirers back which gateway.

source_name: S&P Global Ratings — Banking Industry Country Risk Assessment (BICRA) update, incl. Slovakia
why_relevant: Monthly BICRA table gives Slovakia's banking-system group score plus economic and industry risk scores — a compact, comparable, independent read on SK banking-system risk that no issuer publishes about itself.

source_name: S&P Global Ratings — regulatory disclosure / research articles on Slovak banks
why_relevant: S&P rates Tatra banka and VÚB; regulatory-disclosure articles publish rating rationale and key ratios free of charge, and S&P has taken upgrades on SK banks tied to improving economic/industry risk.

source_name: CEE Fintech Atlas – Slovak fintech ecosystem profile
why_relevant: Regional mapping initiative with a dedicated SK ecosystem write-up; useful for baseline structure and for names of older SK fintech actors, though the entry is dated.

source_name: J&T FINANCE GROUP SE — consolidated annual report (vyrocni zprava)
why_relevant: Parent holding of J&T Banka and (until the KBC deal) 365.bank; its consolidated annual report breaks out subsidiary contributions (J&T Banka EUR 250m, 365.bank EUR 70m of a EUR 338m 2024 group profit) and Slovak bond-arranging volumes. The only consolidated view of the largest domestically-controlled SK banking group.

source_name: LobbyFacts / EU Transparency Register datacard — Slovenská banková asociácia
why_relevant: Mirrors the association's EU Transparency Register filing: declared lobbying budget, staff FTEs, policy files of interest and meetings — quantified, dated self-disclosure about the association's priorities that its own website does not publish.

source_name: Orion Innovation — Temenos partner/licensing announcements covering Slovakia
why_relevant: System-integrator press releases reveal which markets (explicitly Slovakia) a core-banking stack is being pushed into and who the implementation partner would be — an early indicator of pipeline before any bank announces.

source_name: Slovensko.sk — 'Zverejňovanie finančných výsledkov firiem' life-situation guide
why_relevant: Official state explanation of who must file what, where and by when (RÚZ vs Obchodný vestník vs zbierka listín), including audit thresholds. Sets the expected filing calendar and completeness baseline for the collector.
